# CloudStore operations
Requests, dependencies and order delivery. Use the attached Application Insights resource. Sampled telemetry is diagnostic evidence, not an accounting ledger.

content.query: requests | where timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize Requests=sum(itemCount), Failures=sumif(itemCount, success == false), P95ms=percentile(duration,95) by cloud_RoleName, bin(timestamp,1h)
content.title: Request health and latency

content.query: dependencies | where timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize Calls=sum(itemCount), Failures=sumif(itemCount, success == false), P95ms=percentile(duration,95) by cloud_RoleName, type, target
content.title: Dependencies

content.query: traces | where timestamp > ago(24h) and message startswith 'CloudStore order delivery' | summarize Events=sum(itemCount) by message, bin(timestamp,1h)
content.title: Order delivery outcomes
